title: Small-Job Surcharge on Extra Fittings — Marlowe & Finch Alterations Band Schedule
content:
A small-job surcharge is added to a Marlowe & Finch Alterations extra fitting from the ticket's chargeable work, which is its operation charges less every waiver booked on the ticket.

| Chargeable work on the ticket | Small-job surcharge |
|---|---|
| under 75.00 USD | 4.00 USD |
| 75.00 to 99.99 USD | 2.00 USD |
| 100.00 USD or more | none |

**What is counted.** The total of the operation charges booked on the ticket, less every waiver booked on it, whatever kind of waiver it is. Lined surcharges, the rush fee and extra fitting fees are not operation charges and are not added in.

## Band edges, both sides

| Chargeable work | Surcharge |
|---|---|
| 74.99 USD | 4.00 USD |
| 75.00 USD | 2.00 USD |
| 99.99 USD | 2.00 USD |
| 100.00 USD | none |

## Hypothetical illustration

A ticket with operation charges of 145.00 USD and 75.00 USD carries waivers of 28.00 USD and 40.00 USD. Its chargeable work is 220.00 USD less 68.00 USD, that is 152.00 USD: no surcharge. Had the waivers totalled 130.00 USD, the chargeable work would be 90.00 USD: 2.00 USD.
